import sys, io, struct
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import zstandard as zstd
d = zstd.ZstdDecompressor()
p = zstd.ZstdCompressionParameters.from_level(3, write_content_size=False)
c3 = zstd.ZstdCompressor(compression_params=p)
fr3 = c3.compress(b'xyz'*1000)
print('fr3 hdr', fr3[:6].hex())
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(fr3))
print('unknown size read', len(r.read(100000)))
try:
    print('decompress()', len(d.decompress(fr3)))
except Exception as e:
    print('decompress err', type(e).__name__, e)
print('gfp', zstd.get_frame_parameters(fr3[:5]).content_size, zstd.get_frame_parameters(fr3[:5]).window_size)
fre = zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(b'')
print('empty frame', fre[:8].hex(), len(fre))
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(fre)); print('empty read', r.read(100))
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(b'')); print('noinput read', r.read(100))
# skippable only
sk = struct.pack('<II',0x184d2a50,3)+b'abc'
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(sk), read_across_frames=True)
print('skiponly', r.read(100))
# garbage
try:
    r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(b'abcdefgh')); print('garbage', r.read(100))
except Exception as e:
    print('garbage err', type(e).__name__, e)
# many frames concatenated & across
data=b'0123456789'*50
f=zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(data)
blob=f+f+f
r=d.stream_reader(io.BytesIO(blob), read_across_frames=True)
out=b''
while True:
    c=r.read(4096)
    if not c: break
    out+=c
print('three', len(out), out==data*3)
# window size large? test params of a big-window frame
print('gfp2', zstd.get_frame_parameters(f[:14]).window_size, zstd.get_frame_parameters(f[:14]).content_size)
# dict frame
try:
    print(zstd.get_frame_parameters(b''))
except Exception as e:
    print('gfp empty err', type(e).__name__, e)
EOF
